Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE realistic, polished production-quality UI mockup for Sanctuary Launcher, a desktop Minecraft community launcher based on Prism. This is a single static screen, not code or a clickable prototype. Current date anchor: November 8, 2026. All account details and occupancy are fictional demo data.

INPUT IMAGE: the attached white Sanctuary Launcher mockup is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve its crisp white base surface, restrained GitHub/Primer-inspired sans serif typography, thin grey dividers, dark text, generous centered margins, small green status marks and compact utility controls. Completely replace its old five-row checklist with exactly THREE conceptual sections named "Mes comptes", "Mon accès", "Mon jeu". Do not retain a five-step completion counter, an obligatory code step, or a checklist of five tasks.

TARGET DIMENSIONS: 1487 x 1058 pixels, matching the reference aspect ratio. App content only, flat front-facing full viewport. No desktop, device, browser chrome or surrounding mockup frame. White opaque background, not transparent. A centered content column roughly 970px wide, generous margins, tidy intentional spacing. Typography body 15-17px equivalent, clear section headings, comfortable line lengths. Exactly one screen, no inset screen or multiple variants.

STATE: Returning player already linked both accounts, admission confirmed by server, game installed, ready to play, and recognized as a historical beta player. Nothing is pending. One clear primary action: Jouer.

COMPOSITION AND EXACT FRENCH COPY:
- Quiet top header: "Sanctuary" in bold simple text followed by lighter "Launcher". At the far right a tiny green dot and "Serveur en ligne · 12/20". This means simultaneous occupancy only; never label the community as limited to twenty members.
- Thin full-column grey divider.
- Modest welcoming title "Bienvenue sur Sanctuary", with one muted line "Tout est prêt pour rejoindre le serveur."
- Three vertically stacked flat sections on the same white surface, separated by whitespace and fine grey rules. Not three raised cards, no nested cards and no shadows. Section titles should be the dominant navigation and perfectly aligned.

1. "Mes comptes".
   Under it, two compact aligned account rows or a balanced pair within this ONE section:
   "Discord" with demo identity "camille" and small green check plus "Connecté";
   "Microsoft" with "Minecraft Java vérifié" and small green check plus "Connecté".
   Show concise quiet "Gérer mes comptes" utility text link. Do not use real emails, real avatars, credentials or tokens. These are account rows, not separate numbered onboarding stages.

2. "Mon accès".
   Main status green check + "Accès accordé".
   A small tasteful neutral outlined badge near this status, reading EXACTLY "Joueur historique de la bêta". This badge is an informative history distinction, not a further task and not a VIP or paid status.
   Below: "Votre accès au serveur est confirmé."
   A small collapsed disclosure row "Afficher mon code SGA" with a chevron, followed by a subtle "Facultatif" label. Supporting muted copy "Aucun code à saisir pour jouer." The code is hidden until requested. Do NOT show a giant code, a code input field, a required checkbox, a checkmark for code, or a mandatory activation step. No need to render the glyphs in this collapsed state.

3. "Mon jeu".
   "Sanctuary Beta" with a small green "Installé" status.
   Muted short sentence "Votre installation est prête et personnalisable."
   One strong, compact GitHub-like green filled primary button "Jouer", with adequate width, aligned with the beginning of the content. Alongside or below it three smaller neutral outlined utility buttons "Mods", "Shaders", "Réglages".
   The large primary action must be visually stronger than code and account utilities.

- Quiet footer separated by a fine line: links "Actualités", "Site Sanctuary", "Aide". At bottom right tiny muted "Maquette · données fictives".
Keep all accents and exact spelling readable, especially "Mes comptes", "Mon accès", "Mon jeu", "Joueur historique de la bêta", "Facultatif", "Réglages".
No landscape, Minecraft dirt, pixel font, stone texture, oversized logos, gradients, glowing accents, decorative art, extra statistics, left sidebar, five-step progress bar, rainbow badges, or marketing cards. No additional features. Use green only for real ready/connected states and the Jouer primary button; neutral historical badge. Overall feeling: calm, white, centered, practical and welcoming, very clean like a well-crafted GitHub account/settings page, while still recognizable as Sanctuary.
